process.text: A simple four-step rhythm that keeps volunteers and participants moving together.

steps.title: Understand
steps.text: We listen first — clarify the problem, the people involved and what success looks like.

steps.title: Visualize
steps.text: Ideas are mapped into diagrams and models so everyone sees the same picture.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Small, testable steps — prototypes, analyses and drafts reviewed by peers and mentors.

steps.title: Share & Grow
steps.text: Results are presented, published openly and carried forward into the next idea.

why.text: Volunteering here is more than giving time — it is a place to practice leadership, sharpen technical skill and build things that matter.

items.title: Real project experience
items.text: Work on genuine problems and ventures — material you can show in a portfolio or CV.

items.title: Mentors & peers
items.text: Learn alongside people from different disciplines, and get honest, constructive feedback.

items.title: Leadership roles
items.text: Lead a workshop, a program or a small team — responsibility grows with your initiative.

items.title: Open & accessible
items.text: Everything we make is shared openly so more learners can benefit.

items.title: Flexible commitment
items.text: Contribute a few hours a week around your studies or work — no rigid schedules.

items.title: Recognition
items.text: Contributions are credited and acknowledged, and strong volunteers earn references.

band.title: Have a problem, an idea or time to give?
band.text: Whether you want to learn, mentor or build — there is a place for you at Tarafder Informatics Ltd.
